# Verbatim sample of the tekton-pipelines-controller /metrics response.
# Captured 2026-09-13 from the live Frank cluster (Tekton v1.6.0); see
# controller-series-census.json for provenance and the true series counts.

# Complete for every pipelinerun_* series (the ones the alert rules query).
# Every other metric is truncated to its first 3 samples — enough to pin
# label SHAPE without committing 5700 per-pod series. The census file, not
# this one, is the source of truth for cardinality.
#
